<thought>We need to obtain the possible precursors by applying template 1914385 to the given target molecule SMILES. The appropriate tool is apply_template, which returns a list of precursor SMILES strings (or list of lists if multiple outcomes). We'll call it with the target SMILES and the template ID.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O", "template_id": "1914385"}</action_input>
